title: Migraine in the elderly – prevalence, impact and associations with cardiovascular risk factors
summary: The study aims to determine the prevalence and burden of migraine in nursing and retirement homes. In addition, we would like to identify associations between migraine in old age and cardiovascular factors, endothelial (dys)function and arterial stiffness.

interventions.name:
Residents of retirement and nursing homes
Recording of headaches using the EuroLight questionnaire, recording of the effects of headache on daily life using HIT-6, recording of mental health using HADS Depression and Anxiety Questions, physical health status: physical examination and blood sampling

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
- Resident of a retirement or nursing home
- At least 17 points on the Mini-Mental State Examination test (-> no indication of moderate or worse dementia)
Exclusion criteria:
- legal representation through others in healthcare questions
- lacking informed consent
